name: Collaborative Meeting & Coding Platform
summary: Meet, discuss, and work on code in one shared workspace.
description: A final-year project combining online meetings with a collaborative coding workspace. The platform brings together a Next.js interface, an ASP.NET Core backend, a Monaco editor, and LiveKit integration.
technologies: Next.js, ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 / .NET 9, Monaco Editor, LiveKit, GitHub Actions, Vercel
challenge: Meeting participants need to move between conversations and code while keeping file ownership, session activity, and previous versions understandable.
approach: Combine the meeting experience with a file-based Monaco workspace. Use checkout and heartbeat lifecycle handling to manage editing sessions, with version history for reviewing earlier work. Deploy the frontend through GitHub Actions to Vercel.
